FROM centos:latest

# Update and install dependencies
RUN yum update -y && \
  yum install -y epel-release && \
  yum install -y clang cmake3 gcc-c++ make expect vim-common && \
  yum clean all

# Clone fish-shell repository
ADD . /src
WORKDIR /src

# Build fish
RUN cmake3 . && \
  make && \
  make install

# Run tests
CMD make test
